documents.title: Alarm Register - Unit 200 (sheet of the instrument index workbook)
Loop Register - Unit 200 (sheet of the instrument index workbook)
Re-range PT-2013 fuel gas supply pressure from 0-10 to 0-16 barg (new supply header rating)
Extend the SIF-200-05 proof test interval from 12 to 24 months to align with the heater turnaround
Temporary: disable LAH-2031 while the LT-2031 impulse lines are re-routed
Lower the PAH-2041 expansion drum pressure alarm limit from 6.0 to 5.5 barg (new blanket gas regulator setting)
Add PAH-2014 at 2.4 barg on PT-2014, independent of PIC-2012 (LOPA revalidation action for S-200-03)
Remove LAL-2031 fuel gas KO drum low level alarm (proposed as a nuisance alarm)
Temporary: bypass PT-2010A for transmitter replacement
Increase the TAH-2023 on-delay from 30 s to 60 s (chattering during burner changes)
P&ID - Hot Oil Heater H-201 and Hot Oil Circuit
Operating Procedure - Hot Oil Heater Start-up and Shutdown
SIS I/O Allocation and Application Logic - SIS-LS-200
